description: This file contains implementation of NTLM authentication functions, including hash generation, response creation, and target info updates, for the Chromium project.

methods.name: UpdateTargetInfoAvPairs
methods.description: Updates the target info AV pairs with flags, channel bindings, and target name based on parameters.

methods.name: WriteUpdatedTargetInfo
methods.description: Serializes the AV pairs into a buffer for transmission.

methods.name: Splay56To64
methods.description: Converts a 7-byte (56-bit) key into an 8-byte (64-bit) key with parity bits.

methods.name: Create3DesKeysFromNtlmHash
methods.description: Creates three DES keys from an NTLM hash for encryption.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmHashV1
methods.description: Generates an NTLM hash from a password.

methods.name: GenerateResponseDesl
methods.description: Generates an NTLM response using DES encryption.

methods.name: GenerateResponsesV1
methods.description: Generates both LM and NTLM responses.

methods.name: GenerateLMResponseV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates an LM response with session security.

methods.name: GenerateSessionHashV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates a session hash for NTLMv1 with session security.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmResponseV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates an NTLMv1 response with session security.

methods.name: GenerateResponsesV1WithSessionSecurity
methods.description: Generates LM and NTLM responses with session security.

methods.name: GenerateNtlmHashV2
methods.description: Generates an NTLMv2 hash from domain, username, and password.

methods.name: GenerateProofInputV2
methods.description: Creates proof input data for NTLMv2.

methods.name: GenerateSessionBaseKeyV2
methods.description: Generates a session key for NTLMv2.

methods.name: GenerateChannelBindingHashV2
methods.description: Creates a hash of channel bindings for NTLMv2.

methods.name: GenerateUpdatedTargetInfo
methods.description: Creates updated target info AV pairs.
